Anything else must be listed here with a reason. Each entry names a file and a key (a substring of the className string); one entry per component, never a glob. An entry matching no hit FAILS the check (stale). Unlisted hits FAIL. Rule (lead, revised): the one ring applies to all standalone actions AND form controls on SAOC surfaces.
